stories.headline: Bluesky Crosses 30 Million Users as Decentralized Social Media Gains Mainstream Traction
stories.excerpt: Bluesky's AT Protocol network reached 30 million registered users, with daily active usage growing 40 percent quarter-over-quarter. The milestone comes as researchers, journalists, and developers increasingly cite the platform as their primary venue for professional discourse.
stories.licenceBasis: Bluesky AT Protocol — public posts, fair use commentary

stories.headline: MiniMax M3 Drops as Open-Weight Frontier Model With 1M Token Context Window
stories.excerpt: Chinese AI lab MiniMax released M3, an open-weight model combining frontier-tier software engineering capabilities with a one-million-token context window and native multi-modal computer use. Benchmark evaluations show it competitive with premium proprietary offerings from OpenAI and Anthropic, marking another step in open-source models breaking the grip of AI giants.
stories.licenceBasis: Hacker News public API — titles and links, discussion linked out

stories.headline: Artemis I Launch: NASA Returns to the Moon After 50 Years
stories.excerpt: The official NASA broadcast of the Artemis I launch captures the Space Launch System's maiden flight, sending an uncrewed Orion capsule on a 25-day lunar flyby that paves the way for crewed missions.

stories.headline: How The Economic Machine Works: Understanding Monetary Policy in 30 Minutes
stories.excerpt: Ray Dalio's animated explainer breaks down the mechanics of credit, interest rates, and central bank policy — the framework behind every Federal Reserve decision.
stories.licenceBasis: Federal Reserve public domain — official minutes and statements

stories.headline: Meta Breach Exposes 200 Million US Accounts in One of the Largest Data Leaks of 2026
stories.excerpt: A massive data breach at Meta exposed personal information of approximately 200 million US-based accounts, including email addresses, phone numbers, and partial payment details. Security researchers discovered the data circulating on dark web forums within hours of the breach disclosure.

stories.headline: Clean Energy Outgenerates Coal Worldwide for First Time in History
stories.excerpt: For the first time, clean energy sources generated more electricity globally than coal over a full half-year period. Solar drove 83% of new electricity demand growth and now produces 58% of all new generation capacity added worldwide, according to updated tracking data.
stories.licenceBasis: NOAA public domain climate and energy data

stories.headline: Microsoft AutoGen v0.4 Rewrite Prompts Community Fork as Multi-Agent Framework Splinters
stories.excerpt: Microsoft's major rewrite of its AutoGen multi-agent framework for v0.4 drew strong reactions from the developer community, prompting a fork by contributors who preferred the original architecture. The split highlights growing tensions in the open-source AI ecosystem between corporate-driven rewrites and community-maintained stability.
stories.licenceBasis: Hacker News public API — titles and links, discussion linked out

stories.headline: UN Global Stocktake Review Opens With Calls to Triple Renewable Capacity by 2030
stories.excerpt: The first comprehensive review of Global Stocktake implementation began in Geneva, with 194 nations required to demonstrate tangible progress on commitments to triple renewable energy capacity and double energy efficiency improvements by 2030. Early reports suggest most major emitters are behind schedule.
stories.licenceBasis: AI synthesis from UN News and Reuters reporting

stories.headline: Massive Infostealer Log Dump Compromises Millions of Browser Cookies and Saved Passwords
stories.excerpt: A colossal repository of Infostealer malware logs was published on underground forums, compromising millions of browser cookies and saved passwords worldwide. Security analysts warn the dump enables session hijacking at scale, bypassing even multi-factor authentication for affected accounts.

stories.headline: ESA's Hera Spacecraft Arrives at Didymos to Study DART Impact Aftermath
stories.excerpt: The European Space Agency's Hera mission arrived at the Didymos-Dimorphos binary asteroid system to conduct a detailed survey of the crater left by NASA's DART mission, which intentionally collided with Dimorphos in 2022. The data will help scientists understand how kinetic impactors can deflect potentially hazardous asteroids.

stories.headline: China Installs World's First Terawatt of Solar Capacity, Records First-Ever CO₂ Decline
stories.excerpt: China crossed the one-terawatt mark for installed solar photovoltaic capacity and simultaneously recorded its first-ever year-over-year decline in carbon dioxide emissions. The milestone underscores China's dominant position in global renewable energy deployment.
stories.licenceBasis: AI synthesis from RMI and IEA energy reports
